notes:
One balloon at a time.

When two speech balloons sat side by side in neighbouring panels, read-along was reading them a piece at a time — half of one person's sentence, then half of the other's, then the rest of the first. It's the worst thing a page can do and it's fixed.

A page from Tales of Demons and Gods went from eight scrambled fragments to six whole balloons, each read start to finish before the next panel begins.

Vertical webtoons are unaffected — their balloons stack, so there was nothing to scramble. This is for pages laid out in panels across the width.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
